title: Cogitave marketing Page (content-as-data)
description: Structured content model for a marketing page. Mirrors the docs/learn model: a typed document (first line `### YamlMime:Page` in the .yml), front-matter-style metadata, UID identity, and prose modeled as DATA (semantic blocks) — never as layout. The block `type` carries meaning; how it renders is a /components concern. This is what makes content portable to web, AI answers, and other channels.

uid.description: Immutable dotted UID, e.g. cogitave.web.page.home. Identity is decoupled from route/path.

description.description: 75-300 chars (same window as the docs standard); used as the default meta description.

blocks.description: Ordered semantic content blocks. Each references a component by `type`; content is data.

type.description: Semantic block type, resolved to a shared component, e.g. hero | feature-grid | logo-wall | testimonial | cta | faq | rich-text.

data.description: Block-specific fields validated by the component's own sub-schema (registered in /components).

include.description: Optional path to a separate .md prose file (prose lives apart from the data, as in the docs `includes/` convention).
